scene.description: Vertical 4:5 cinematic editorial photograph of a single outdoor wedding reception at golden hour with string lights and a white tent in the distance, split into two halves by a thin vertical line at the exact centre. The LEFT half shows a woman in her thirties, a wedding guest in a long emerald cocktail dress with her hair in a low bun, standing in front of a generic blue plastic portable construction-site toilet, its door already half open; she is about to step in, leaning slightly back with a clear look of dislike (nose slightly wrinkled, eyebrows drawn together). Left light is cool, flat and slightly desaturated. The RIGHT half shows THE SAME woman, same dress, same hair, same venue, same time of day, stepping toward the steps of the white luxury Mônaco mobile restroom trailer whose door is half open with warm light glowing inside; her expression is pleasant surprise and admiration (eyebrows lifted, soft smile). Right light is warm gold. The trailer must replicate IMAGEM 1 exactly. Both halves share the same lawn, tent and sky so it reads as one continuous scene with a temperature split. Top 340px of the frame is open sky and trees for the headline. Palette: cool blue-grey left, warm gold and white right, navy #0F1D45 gradient at the top.
